cells.gaps: No source found says Morocco AI 2030 has been adopted or validated: the minister presented AI Made in Morocco in January 2026 (MAR-007) and told parliament on 10 November 2026 that he was launching Morocco AI 2030, with no adoption stated. Digital Morocco 2030 names AI as one lever of a digital strategy. The JAZARI network (MAR-008) is a pillar of the roadmap, not a body named to carry it out.
cells.note: Bill's ruling (messages-for-bill 132): a minister's launch is not adoption, and formal validation is needed. Fact 2026-11-26: the January 2026 presentation of AI Made in Morocco states no adoption either, so stage 2.
